description: This file defines API route handlers for managing boards in a project, including creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, duplicating, undeleting, and fetching metadata of boards. It uses Gorilla Mux for routing and interacts with application logic and permissions.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API handler struct that contains dependencies for handling board-related API requests.

methods.name: registerBoardsRoutes
methods.description: Registers HTTP routes for board operations.

methods.name: handleGetBoards
methods.description: Handles retrieving list of boards for a team.

methods.name: handleGetBoard
methods.description: Handles retrieving a specific board by ID.

methods.name: handlePatchBoard
methods.description: Handles partial update of a board.

methods.name: handleUndeleteBoard
methods.description: Handles undeleting a previously deleted board.

methods.name: handleGetBoardMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific board.
